newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan bourse dominated by sole hotel stock.
newsitem.headline: Jordan bourse dominated by sole hotel stock.

text.p: Jordanian shares fell slightly on Sunday in the heaviest trade this year dominated by a large bloc sale in Jordan Hotel Tourism Company, dealers said.
The official Amman Financial Market 60-share index shed 0.07 percent to 151.64 points in high turnover of 13,708,309 dinars ($19,362,018).
The heavy turnover was accounted for by one blocK sale of 1.5 million shares valued at 12.5 million dinars in Jordan Hotels and Tourism Company, which owns the five-star Intercontinental.
Brokers said the remaining trade was mostly portfolio buying to prop up closing prices of stocks in end-of-year "window dressing" transactions.
Heavy weight Arab Bank, the second busiest stock, shed 1 dinars to 249 dinars with 2,480 shares worth 619,027 dinars changing hands.
Middle East Investment Bank continued to be a target of investor buying with a 0.01 dinar rise to 1.07 dinars.
Insurance company Al-Nisr al-Arabi continued its unpward trend to rise 4.93 percent to 6.17 dinars on expectations that the one million dinar capitalised firm could issue a 20 percent cash dividend.
The private Pearl Investable Index of the 45 best performing shares on the exchange shed 0.01 percent to 82.75 points from 82.76 points, still 13.36 percent down from the start of the year.
Losing shares outnumbered gainers on Sunday by 29 to 17, with shares in six other firms trading but closing unchanged.
